en: A black‑and‑white street view of a mid‑20th‑century town. The scene shows a relatively wide street lined with multi‑storey functionalist buildings. In the left foreground is a two‑storey building with large windows and flags; a sign reads "APOTEK" indicating a pharmacy on the ground floor. Period automobiles and a few pedestrians are visible along the street. At the bottom left and right corners there is white caption text identifying the location and the photo/publisher details.
